description: Katale AI voice-commerce evaluation set. English clips are synthetic (macOS `say`, Ogg/Opus mono 16 kHz, WhatsApp-like) in tests/fixtures/voice. Luganda entries record real merchant voice notes tested over WhatsApp; recordings are NOT committed, only reference transcripts and observed results.

cases.reference: Create an order for Sarah for ten handmade baskets at twelve dollars each and add twenty dollars shipping.
Create an order for Sarah for some baskets.
Create an order for Sarah for twenty baskets at one thousand dollars each.
cases.note: Backend must flag the catalog-price override and refuse the $20,000 payment request (limit $10,000).

cases.reference: How much have I sold this week?
